label: Conspiracy that was TRUE

szenen.text: A president's tapes had an *18-minute gap.*
It started with a *break-in* on June 17, 1972.
Five men were *arrested* inside Democratic headquarters.
Nixon secretly *recorded* conversations in the White House.
A subpoenaed tape from *June 20, 1972* had a gap.
The White House revealed it in *November 1973.*
Another tape showed him *blocking the FBI.*
He resigned on *August 9, 1974.* Could it happen again?
